The name of the scaling configuration. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length and can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). It must start with a digit, letter, or Chinese character.

The name must be unique within a scaling group in a region. If you do not specify this parameter, the ID of the scaling configuration is used by default

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the security group to which the ECI instances belong. ECI instances in the same security group can access each other.

If you do not specify a security group, the system automatically uses the default security group in the selected region. You must ensure that the inbound rules of this security group include the protocols and ports that the containers need to expose. If no default security group exists in the region, the system performs the automatic creation of a default security group and adds the declared container protocols and ports to the inbound rules of the security group
parameters.help_zh:
ECI实例所属的安全组ID。同一个安全组内的ECI实例之间可以互相访问。

如果没有指定安全组，系统将自动使用您选择的地域下的默认安全组，您需要确保该安全组的入方向规则中包含容器需要暴露的协议和端口。如果您在该地域下没有默认安全组，系统将自动创建一个默认安全组，并将您声明的容器协议和端口添加到该安全组的入方向规则中
parameters.name: security_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the ECI instance, which is the name of the container group.

To set sequential instance names, use the following format: name_prefix(AUTO_INCREMENT)[begin_number,bits]name_suffix.

name_prefix: the prefix of the hostname.

(AUTO_INCREMENT): a fixed value used to identify this sorting method.

begin_number: the start value of the sequential number. Valid values: 0 to 999999.

bits: the number of digits of the sequential number. Valid values: 1 to 6. If the number of digits of the specified begin_number is greater than the value of bits, bits defaults to 6.
<notice>We recommend that you set bits to at least 3. Otherwise, the upper limit of the sequential number may be easily reached. After the upper limit is reached, if scale-out is still required, the scaling activity fails and stops. In this case, you must reset the rules for generating hostnames.</notice>

name_suffix (optional): the suffix of the hostname.

<notice>No spaces are allowed in [begin_number,bits]. The system increments the number sequentially by default. However, if an ECI instance created during scale-out fails to start, the instance is removed from the scaling group and a new ECI instance is created. Therefore, the hostnames of ECI instances in the scaling group may be incremented discontinuously.</notice>

Example: If you set the value to nginx-test-(AUTO_INCREMENT)[0,3], the container group names are nginx-test-000, nginx-test-001, and nginx-test-002.

The rules for setting sequential ECI instance names are the same as those for setting sequential instance names in an ECS scaling group. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203831.html
parameters.help_zh:
ECI实例名称，即容器组名称。

如果需要设置有序实例名称，格式为name_prefix(AUTO_INCREMENT)[begin_number,bits]name_suffix。

name_prefix：指定主机名称的前缀。

(AUTO_INCREMENT)：固定值，用来标识此排序方式。

begin_number：有序数值的起始值，取值范围：[0,999999]。

bits：有序数值所占的位数，取值范围：[1,6]，当指定的begin_number位数大于bits的取值时，bits默认为6。
<notice>bits建议最少为3，否则容易达到有序数值的上限。在达到上限后，若还有扩容需求，伸缩活动会报错，并停止扩容。此时，您需要重新设置生成主机名称的规则。</notice>

name_suffix（可选）：指定主机名称的后缀。

<notice>[begin_number,bits]中不能有空格，且系统默认依次递增，但是如果存在扩容的ECI实例无法启动，会被伸缩组移除后再扩容一台新的ECI实例，所以伸缩组内ECI实例的主机名称可能断续递增。</notice>

示例： 当设置为nginx-test-(AUTO_INCREMENT)[0,3]时，容器组名称为nginx-test-000、nginx-test-001、nginx-test-002。

设置ECI有序实例名称的规则与设置ECS伸缩组有序实例规格相同，具体规则介绍，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/203831.html

parameters.help_en:
The instance family level. This parameter is used to filter instance types that meet the requirements and takes effect only when CostOptimization is enabled. Valid values:

EntryLevel: entry-level, which refers to shared instance types. Shared instance types are more cost-effective but cannot guarantee consistent computing performance. They are suitable for business scenarios with low CPU utilization. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/108489.html.
EnterpriseLevel: enterprise-level. Enterprise-level instance types provide consistent performance and dedicated resources. They are suitable for business scenarios that require high stability. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html.
CreditEntryLevel: credit-based entry-level, which refers to burstable instances. Burstable instances use CPU credits to maintain computing performance and are suitable for business scenarios with low baseline CPU utilization and occasional CPU bursts. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59977.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格族级别，用于筛选符合要求的实例规格范围，当`CostOptimization`开启时生效。可能值：

EntryLevel：入门级，即共享型实例规格。成本更低，但是无法保证实例计算性能的稳定。适用于平时CPU使用率低的业务场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/108489.html。
EnterpriseLevel：企业级。性能稳定且资源独享，适用于对稳定性要求高的业务场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25378.html。
CreditEntryLevel：积分入门级，即突发性能实例。通过CPU积分来保证计算性能，适用于平时CPU使用率低、偶有突发CPU使用率的业务场景。更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/59977.html
